note: Recommended type shortlist for weak/cheap models. The full manifest stays the single source of truth — this file is a curation layer on top of it, not a replacement. Every family here is status=ok in assets/fonts/fonts.json (passes the 2026-11-09 shaping/collision gate, < 0.20 on 'النهاردة' @ 54px). Families measured >= 0.20 carry status=review in the manifest and are deliberately absent from this list.
evidence: tests/test_fonts.py (shape/collision gate) · assets/fonts/fonts.json (status per family) · docs/fonts.md (measured ratios)

policy.weak_models: Pick from shortlist.json only; anything else needs a written reason and still goes through the collision gate.
policy.strong_models: May pick any manifest family with status=ok; status=review only deliberately (texture-driven), never for body text.
policy.review_families: Jomhuria, Aref Ruqaa, Aref Ruqaa Ink, Noto Nastaliq Urdu, Gulzar, Noto Sans Arabic, Estedad, Reem Kufi, Reem Kufi Fun, Reem Kufi Ink, Mirza, Noto Naskh Arabic, Noto Kufi Arabic, Katibeh, Fustat — measured >= 0.20 on 2026-11-09; see docs/fonts.md.
policy.fallback: Cairo (Arabic) / Inter (Latin) remain last-resort system-chrome nets, not creative picks.

families.why: heavy display for the hook word and big numbers — the studio's proven loud opener
geometric headline + Latin digits; short confident lines for tools/product reels
neutral body and system-chrome fallback — versatile, never a forced creative default
technical/UI: data rows, device screens, label+number pairs — one superfamily feel
small captions and long body — maximum legibility where personality is secondary
kufic statement for chapter cards, poster frames, one-word impact lines
modern clean Arabic+Latin — UI/body with a contemporary display edge
warm Egyptian display — personal, human openers without a corporate feel
neutral Latin body — matches Cairo; the Latin half of the fallback net
technical display — product names, engineering-flavored headers
code, specs, telemetry — figures that must line up in columns
one heavy weight — hook, one huge number, CTA; pairs with the Arabic display tier
the Latin half of the Plex superfamily — sits 1:1 against Plex Sans Arabic
